inventory.source_note: Stable source-order identifiers preserve the saved Gutenberg units without semantic merges. These are package identifiers; identity with identifiers from another inventory is not asserted.
inventory.word_count_definition: sum(len(unit.text.split())); note labels are included; inline HTML superscripts remain joined to their words; page labels and digital controls/notices are excluded.
inventory.note_frame_voice: Explicit note signatures identify the frame only; embedded document writers and unsigned later biographies are separately qualified.
inventory.semantic_overlay_note: Public voice, note-frame, document and source-evidence annotations are already included in units.json and notes-inventory.json. Source French text and saved HTML/TXT bytes have not been corrected by these annotations.

verification.coverage_scope: Every nonblank text node in downloaded official HTML belongs to a retained unit, preserved digital exclusion, page marker, or Gutenberg boilerplate. No claim that Gutenberg captured every printed element of the 1891 edition.

parser_environment.line_endings: Official files retain CRLF bytes; this libxml2 parser retains CR in DOM text and lxml serialization renders it as . Newer libxml2 may normalize CRLF to LF; stored source_html hashes are defined by this recorded parser and serialization.

limitations: Unit IDs are package identifiers and are not certified to match other inventories.
No complete collation with the printed 1891 facsimile; completeness refers to the downloaded Gutenberg HTML.
Gutenberg credits BnF/Gallica images but supplies no verified Gallica ARK here.
The collected NOTES heading and relocation of footnotes are digital presentation; original pagination of note text is not asserted.
Nested notes 264-a through 264-g are substantive historical annotations within note 264, with printed provenance pending facsimile confirmation.
Voice classification is conservative, structural and partly unresolved; embedded quotes can coexist with the frame voice.
The retained original title-page rights notice is historical text; it is not a claim of current copyright.
Legacy-named files are the current official files-route source, revised in 2024, not certified original 2010 release bytes.
HTML/TXT alternate renditions are not asserted identical; observed differences are recorded in source-variants.json.
The source contains page-label and date anomalies; source-issues.json records them without altering French readings.
rights_scope: Project Gutenberg identifies public-domain status in the USA only. No separate worldwide copyright clearance or facsimile redistribution permission is asserted.
preservation_scope: Reader-facing preservation bundle of saved source witnesses, stable units, historical notes, source cautions, markers, links and illustration assets. This is not a one-command regeneration build.
